title: News: a platform to publish r/aigamedev games; kids-friendly, non-profit
author: yvo
selftext:
Since a few weeks I've been vibe coding a collection of games with AI (Claude Fable) during late evenings. Goal: fun games for kids with no ads, no in-app purchases or accidental installs or whatever dark pattern kids are currently being exposed/ lured/ tricked into by the current generation 'free' games in the App stores.

Check out my daughter's favourite [Squishy Cup](https://jip.ai/play/squishy-cup) (runner) or my favourite [GoDeliver](https://jip.ai/play/godeliver) (food delivery driver).

All what was missing was a accessible and safe place that would list these games. A **non-profit platform** that would list these games and happy to accept qualitative & creative AI developed games. Unfortunately, there were none, so I asked Fable to build it!

[jip.ai](https://jip.ai/): Free games for kids. No ads, ever.

# Kids & parents:

* kids-friendly games platform
* 10 finished fun games live, 10 more in review
* **free**, no ads, no installs, no buys, no in-app purchases
* **parental controls**: limit play time + screen time insights
* setup family once, cross devices in sync

# AI game devs:

* reach an audience for your AI created games
* AI-developer first: guidelines for an AI gameplay-debug harness, create the right promotional art, gameplay best practices for web, etc.
* AI-reviewed submissions; your AI gets a review to improve by an AI.
* gameplay datapoints: your AI gets real users gameplay feedback on where to improve

  
This new platform could use quality, fun and creative games submissions. And that is where r/aigamedev/ comes in.   
  
Join and invest your creativity and tokens into building one to submit.  
  
Read up on the [rulebook](https://jip.ai/developers) and after point your model to [https://jip.ai/llm.txt](https://jip.ai/llm.txt) on how to submit your game.

[jip.ai](http://jip.ai) could be the alternative future where gaming goes back to the core-metric of being fun, void of ads, rewarded video and paid virtual currencies. Read more on my [why](https://jip.ai/why) and its goals.
